During the reporting period were organized 3 annual advocacy visits to EU The first advocacy visit took place between 29 31 March 2023 in Brussels. The team held advocacy meetings with Luc Pierre Devigne Deputy Director General for Europe and Central Asia representatives from the European External Action Service EEAS and European MPs Siegfried Muresan Drago Tudorache Ramona Strugariu. The discussions focused on the progress made by the Republic of Moldova and the reforms necessary to fulfill the nine recommendations of the European Commission in accordance with the Action Plan approved by the National Commission for European Integration which must be implemented by the authorities to accelerate the accession process.The second advocacy visits took place between 1416 November 2023 in Brussels. The delegation team arranged and held advocacy meetings with MEP Ramona Strugariu and Timea Lapsanszki Policy Advisor of MEP Drago Tudorache Jan Petry Marie Deplace Maia Ignatenko DG JUST Laura Bretea Team Leader for Moldova DG NEAR. During this visit the team also participated at the 15th EaP CSF Annual Assembly. The third advocacy visit took place in Berlin 8 11 October 2024.
